--- title: "[crawl.WebCrawler]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Crawl a website by fetching pages directly over HTTP. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L1218-L1665){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python crawl.WebCrawler( *, session=None, cache_dir=None, cache_stale_after=None, max_workers=1 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A `WebCrawler` starts from one or more root URLs, fetches each page with `requests`, follows discovered links up to `scope.depth`, and yields matching pages as `MarkdownDocument` objects. Link following is constrained by the scope's patterns, types, and the `include_external_links` / `include_subdomains` flags. Fetched response bodies are cached on disk. When `cache_stale_after` is set, fresh cached responses are reused and stale ones are revalidated with `ETag` / `Last-Modified` headers when the server provides them. Pass `cache_force_refresh=True` to any method to bypass the cache for a run. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [session]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [requests.Session | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A `requests.Session` to use for requests. When omitted, a new session is created. A caller-supplied session also scopes the cache so entries are not shared across sessions. [cache_dir]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool | str | Path | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Where to cache fetched bodies. `None` (default) uses a temporary directory. `True` uses `.raghilda/cache/web` under the current working directory. A string or `Path` uses that location. [cache_stale_after]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [timedelta | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : How long a cached body stays fresh before it must be revalidated. When `None` (default), cached bodies are always considered fresh. [max_workers]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of worker threads used to fetch pages concurrently. Must be at least 1. Default is 1. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#06d8964d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from datetime import timedelta from raghilda.crawl import CrawlScope, WebCrawler crawler = WebCrawler(cache_dir=True, cache_stale_after=timedelta(days=1)) scope = CrawlScope( roots=["https://quarto.org/docs/guide/"], depth=2, include_patterns=[r"^https://quarto\.org/docs/guide/"], include_types=["html"], ) for document in crawler.markdown_documents(scope): print(document.origin) ``` ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
fetch_raw() Fetch one URL over HTTP and return its source metadata.
origins() Discover web origins reachable from the scope's roots.
### [fetch_raw()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Fetch one URL over HTTP and return its source metadata. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L1445-L1572){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python fetch_raw(origin, *, cache_force_refresh=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A fresh cached body is returned without a network request. A stale cached body is revalidated with `If-None-Match` / `If-Modified-Since` headers; on a `304 Not Modified` the cached body is reused. Otherwise the body is downloaded, cached, and its content type and type label are recorded on the returned source. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [origin]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The URL to fetch. It is canonicalized before use and must be an `http` or `https` URL. [cache_force_refresh]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : When `True`, ignore any cached body and re-fetch from the server. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [FetchedSource]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The fetched source, with its cached body path and metadata. ::: ### [origins()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Discover web origins reachable from the scope's roots. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L1292-L1443){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python origins(scope, *, progress=True, cache_force_refresh=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Performs a breadth-first crawl: each root is fetched, its links are extracted and canonicalized, and the frontier expands one level per `scope.depth` until the depth or `scope.limit` is reached. Origins outside the root scope are dropped unless `include_external_links` or `include_subdomains` allow them. Only origins passing the scope's pattern and type filters are yielded. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [scope]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [CrawlScope]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The `CrawlScope` describing what to crawl. `roots` must be `http` or `https` URLs. [progress]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Unused; accepted for interface compatibility. [cache_force_refresh]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : When `True`, re-fetch pages instead of using cached bodies while discovering links. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Iterator[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A lazy iterator of unique canonical URLs, in crawl order. :::
